notes.title: New demo, global leaderboard and more options!
notes.content:
Here is a list of features for this long awaited update:

 A world leader board: Compare your score against other people around the world. (Not available in demo)
 Settings menu item with several helpful options including:
  - Different types of indicator for showing piece placement.
  - Turn off or down CRT effects.
  - Turning rumble off.
  - Turning off background animation.
 Plus several other small fixes.

A new Demo is also out now!

notes.title: Update notes for October 20th.
notes.content:
Fixes:

- Achievements for puzzles now trigger when solved.
- Two different menus showing up in certain situations should no longer happen. 
- Fixed some sound issues.

notes.title: RETRIS is out now!
notes.content:
A big thanks to everyone that played during Steam Next Fest. And thanks to the feedback, there are already two new additions to the game:

1. Hard drop a piece.
2. Quick restart.

They are both new buttons/keys that are rebindable!

Hope you enjoy!
